Americans Reject More Canada Tariffs
On Tuesday, the Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 57% of Americans opposed imposing more tariffs on Canadian goods, compared with 20% who supported them.
Meanwhile, 63% opposed Trump’s
, while just 14% backed the move.
The opposition to the lake renaming extended into Trump’s own party. About one-third of Republicans supported the decision, while 43% opposed it. Among Democrats, just 6% approved.

The survey also showed Americans favoring compromise over confrontation. 68% said the U.S. should be willing to make tradeoffs with Canada "even if it means it doesn’t get most of what it wants," while 25% preferred a tougher approach.
Only 4% of respondents expected tariffs to have a mostly positive effect on their personal finances, while 40% anticipated a mostly negative impact.
